cards.review_notes: The introductory description includes rising juniors, seniors, or class of 2026 seniors, but the eligibility requirements list only rising juniors and seniors from rural WNC. The structured grades reflect the eligibility list; confirm whether graduating seniors are eligible. A minimum weighted GPA of 3.0 and a strong desire to pursue healthcare are required. UNC Asheville is the stated overnight venue, but no specific dorm or drop-off location is published; the address is its official general campus address. MAHEC is an activity location and the ropes course is a field trip, so neither is listed as a drop-off site.
